title: Add author attribution and HTML author metadata

requirements.summary: Show an explicit author attribution (“Author: WAMIQ AHMAD”) on the About page footer/credits area.
acceptanceCriteria: On the About page, users can see an explicit author attribution reading "Author: WAMIQ AHMAD" in the footer/credits area.
All user-facing text related to the author attribution is in English.

file_operations.description: Add/verify a visible footer/credits section on the About page that includes the exact English attribution text "Author: WAMIQ AHMAD".

requirements.summary: Add standard HTML head metadata declaring the application author as WAMIQ AHMAD.
acceptanceCriteria: The generated HTML contains <meta name="author" content="WAMIQ AHMAD" /> in the document <head>.

file_operations.description: Add/verify the document head includes the author meta tag with content set to "WAMIQ AHMAD" (meta name="author").
